MATCH_FLAME_ENCHANTMENT.title: 火苗
MATCH_FLAME_ENCHANTMENT.description:
每当打出这张牌，伤害+[blue]{Damage}[/blue]。对目标施加[blue]{Burn}[/blue]层[gold]烧伤[/gold]。
此牌在本场第[blue]{Threshold}[/blue]次及以后打出时，对自己施加[blue]{SelfBurn}[/blue]层[gold]烧伤[/gold]。
